title: August and the Vow
author: Wren Nakamura
blurb: Silas Hartwell, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
